newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish banking climate improves in January - survey.
newsitem.headline: Polish banking climate improves in January - survey.

text.p: Poland's banking climate index "Pengab" rose 11 points to 51.7 in January, a poll released on Tuesday by the private Pentor intitute showed.
The monthly survey showed the index at its second highest level in the last 12 months.
"After December's fall, the index climbed back to high levels at which it was in the September-November 1996 period," Eugeniusz Smilowski, Pentor's director told a news conference.
The index, based on a scale of minus 100 to plus 100, dropped 11 points to 40.4 in December after hitting a record 52.5 in October.
The Pentor survey, which polled 210 bank managers, is commissioned monthly by the Polish Banking Association (ZBP).
